Welcome to Cyrus Says!
Welcome to Cyrus Says! Cyrus Broacha is joined by actor and host Karan Tacker for a candid conversation about his journey from Mumbai's garment business to the world of television, OTT and entertainment.
Karan opens up about growing up in Bandra, working in his father's garment business and how the 2008 financial crisis forced his family to shut down their stores. From putting up an unbelievable *Buy 1, Get 6 Free* sale to being encouraged by a stylist to try acting, Karan shares the unexpected circumstances that shaped his career.
